name: adventurerBackground
description: Appearances, histories, and goals for adventuring NPCs

fields.Appearance: Travel-hardened, lightly scarred, and equipped with carefully maintained but mismatched gear.
fields.Backstory: Survived the destruction of a first expedition and still carries its incomplete map.
fields.Goals: Learn what killed the companions and finish the expedition without repeating their mistakes.

fields.Appearance: Athletic, brightly dressed, and eager to display trophies of doubtful authenticity.
fields.Backstory: Left a comfortable home after stories of heroic ancestors became impossible to ignore.
fields.Goals: Earn genuine renown and discover whether the family legends were true.

fields.Appearance: Quiet, watchful, and dressed in weatherproof layers marked by many repaired tears.
fields.Backstory: Worked as a frontier scout until an employer ordered the abandonment of isolated settlers.
fields.Goals: Guide vulnerable travelers safely and bring the former employer to justice.

fields.Appearance: Academic posture, ink-stained gloves, sturdy boots, and too many fragile instruments.
fields.Backstory: A scholar entered the field when an important theory was dismissed without investigation.
fields.Goals: Find undeniable evidence and survive long enough to publish it.

fields.Appearance: Powerfully built with simple armor, a calm expression, and a visibly damaged shield.
fields.Backstory: A former guard became a monster hunter after ordinary defenses failed the home district.
fields.Goals: Teach settlements practical defenses and locate the creature that escaped.

fields.Appearance: Lean and sunburned, carrying religious tokens gathered from many unrelated faiths.
fields.Backstory: Undertook a pilgrimage to answer a personal miracle but found every shrine offered a different explanation.
fields.Goals: Understand the miracle and help other pilgrims complete dangerous journeys.

fields.Appearance: Cheerful, weathered, and burdened with ropes, tools, samples, and unnecessary souvenirs.
fields.Backstory: Became an explorer through repeated accidents while working as a caravan repairer.
fields.Goals: Map inaccessible routes and open a reliable passage between separated communities.

fields.Appearance: Disciplined stance, old military kit stripped of insignia, and a carefully concealed limp.
fields.Backstory: A veteran left mercenary service after discovering the company's wars were deliberately prolonged.
fields.Goals: Choose honorable contracts and expose the financiers behind the conflicts.

fields.Appearance: Small-framed, quick-moving, and equipped with specialized climbing and lock tools.
fields.Backstory: Started delving into ruins to recover family property sold during a financial crisis.
fields.Goals: Recover the heirloom, pay family debts, and prove caution is more valuable than bravado.

fields.Appearance: Immaculate cloak over battered armor, with a confident smile that fades when alone.
fields.Backstory: Was publicly declared a prophesied hero despite having no evidence the prophecy is genuine.
fields.Goals: Protect people drawn into the prophecy and determine who manufactured it.

fields.Appearance: Severe, pale, and covered with notebooks documenting wounds, tracks, and unusual remains.
fields.Backstory: A healer began studying monsters after conventional medicine failed against supernatural injuries.
fields.Goals: Create reliable treatments and capture a dangerous specimen alive.

fields.Appearance: Older than most adventurers, practical and composed, carrying equipment chosen through long experience.
fields.Backstory: Retired successfully years ago but returned when a former companion's child disappeared.
fields.Goals: Find the missing heir, keep inexperienced allies alive, and retire without unfinished promises.
